answer: Per-identity challenge channel lease: each identity opens a metered channel whose first message solves a hardware-attested challenge tied to a public beacon, then locks 24h before payout. The unlock code sits in a relay vault, so cloning needs a new attestation plus a fixed 5-credit activation fee. Each clone also holds a unique throughput river slot, adding delay until expected take falls below that fee. Nectar clears only after the challenge, making a marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
